main_text.p: OMnia, quæ ex testamento proficiscuntur, ita sta-tum euentus{i} capiunt, si initium{k} quoque si-ne vitio ceperint.

main_text.p: OMnis definitio{l} in iure ciuili periculosa est, pa-rum{m} est enim, vt non subuerti possit [?].

main_text.p: QVod quis ex culpa sua damnum{n} sentit, non [illegible, ~8 letters]bus malis minus eligendum, Odia restringi{o}.

page.notes: Left margin notes a to h are transcribed in full in the left-margin column of the page; a few Greek words in the notes and footnotes are only approximated ([?] or illegible), because the scan is too small to read them letter by letter. The line "bus malis minus eligendum" in the main text is hard to place relative to the margin note "hinc illæ regulæ Ex.duo-"; its exact placement is uncertain. The reference marks o, i, k, l, m, n and the footnote for "{o}" (odia 15. de regulis in 6) are read from the small type and may be incomplete. Two catchword-like marks in the middle of the text were not included. Printed errors are left as printed.
